groups.id: owned generation versus audited editor acceptance
groups.comparison: Core generate explicitly documents construction rejection rather than exhaustive geometric audit; do not treat every BuildingPlan as audit-certified. generate_structure locally derives related towers/stairs/crowns/geometry and wall/opening assemblies from the same program/storeys, constructs one owned plan, then architectural-envelope recipient remains an exact called dependency rather than name-only proof. generate_unchecked runs heating on its local plan before return. generate_document clones program, validates edit archetype applicability, rebuilds from ordered edits, checks actual targeted wall exists and replaces matching override, then audit_plan gates owned result. edit_document clones original document and publishes candidate+plan only after successful rebuild/audit, so rejected edit preserves caller document. Actual audit helper bodies not waived by call.

apply_opening_edits resolves selector in same walls slice, uses actual wall index, rejects unsupported interior window/gate/slit, rejects existing opening, checks kind-specific finite ranges including door/gate sill absolute tolerance, pushes and sorts by wall. NaN fails those comparisons. Remove retains matching indices and refuses missing target. Internal &mut vector may have earlier edits on later Err, but normal editor owns candidate/rebuild and rejects whole result. Entrances derives selected south walls by same room ordinal, takes bounded safe middle slices even empty; exits same north-facing room. Empty requirements or arbitrary raw wall room ordinal is an unsealed private-helper precondition, not an established normal failure because actual allocate/derive_walls guards lie outside this exact fragment.

groups.id: shared boundaries and connected room identity
groups.comparison: room_connections canonicalizes ordered pair of inside/outside RoomIndex and groups actual wall indices in BTreeMap. Both requirements use checked get and return source-bearing storey/room errors. Same-kind repeated rooms remain distinct ordinals; preferred adjacency and StairHall first are ranking not new room identity. Candidate Vec refers same immutable walls, not an unrelated vector. Raw self-room boundary not explicitly refused here, normal derived source precondition remains.

groups.id: stair landing ties semantic rooms to actual boundary
groups.comparison: landing_opening resolves required landing-room kind from current requirements or errors; serializes StoreyIndex fallibly; alternating flight end derives origin+direction*3.2. Selected actual wall must have reserved cell and both StairHall adjacency and a neighbor; output Opening.wall and neighbor/stair_hall from that SAME wall. flight_index subtracts lowest_storey and relies on serves selection, not a general checked API proof. No direct unserved caller established.

groups.id: room growth scoped tail preserves connected frontier
groups.comparison: Actual148–175 room_counts and collect_rooms project assignments against exact requirements; room ordinal conversion checked at collection, index in counts assumes same requirement domain. GrowthCandidate full declaration177–185 is complete only by merging prior140–180 role with mandatory overlay065181–249. grow_rooms194–246 adds one currently unassigned footprint cell adjacent to an existing room, never Passage, ranks fill/preferred/geometry/random with preferred.max1, requires same room seed, and errors if no frontier. Strict one-cell insertion advances finite unique footprint when input assignments and footprint correspond; raw duplicate footprint/foreign assignment could violate those private preconditions, normal allocator prefix1–139 excluded. groups.id: heating selected programme and same reservations
groups.comparison: HeatingStorey::for_program uses actual program.storeys.get(index), permits only relevant archetypes with heating, classifies ground/firstupper/all later as support/heated/storage while retaining same programme+ordinal. Positive RearCellOffset constructor rejects<=0, distinct from fine GridLength. Scoped reservation closure tail115–130 returns typed outside/reserved failures and inserts same room; actual prefix75–114 not read or credited, so no whole reservation authority claim. Two-cell bays and Pantry neighbor policy fixed arrays use positive checked offsets. doorway finds exact first/second requirement ordinals, selects same actual shared wall with policy orientation, retargets matching existing Door entries only. Opening.wall membership is inherited from same normal derive_openings, not validated for arbitrary raw input slice. Current occupied fragment invokes heating/allocate/collect/connectivity/derive_walls/openings in order, but starts midway at100 and stops at apply_opening_edits header145, so not whole occupied-storey proof.
